We're hiring a Head of Compliance Product to lead the products at the heart of Elliptic and define what they become in the age of AI.

Compliance is where Elliptic began and where our commercial core sits today. Some of the world's largest exchanges, banks and government agencies rely on our screening, monitoring and investigation products, and the industry they serve is at an inflection point. Compliance teams everywhere are looking to AI to make their work dramatically more efficient, freeing their people to focus on the judgement calls that genuinely need a human, with every automated decision auditable and explainable. Elliptic is building that future with our customers, not just for them, and this role owns it.

You will lead the product managers responsible for our core compliance portfolio, spanning wallet and transaction screening, continuous monitoring, on-chain investigations and risk configuration, and you will drive the product side of our agentic compliance programme alongside our design partners. Much of what you build will have no precedent. You will be inventing the category, inside the company with the data, intelligence and customer trust to win it.

This is a player-coach role reporting to the VP of Product. You will lead and grow a team of product managers and personally own some of the hardest problems on the roadmap. The product organisation is centred in London with a growing US presence.

 
 

What you'll do

  • Own the vision, strategy and roadmap for Elliptic's compliance portfolio, and define what these products become as AI reshapes how compliance work gets done.

  • Lead product for our agentic compliance programme: AI capabilities that make compliance work faster and better, with auditability and explainability designed in from the start.

  • Lead, coach and grow a team of product managers. Hire well, develop people deliberately, and set the standard for how a modern, AI-augmented PM works. Developing product talent is a core output of this role, not a side effect.

  • Stay obsessively close to customers, in creative ways: Methods such as design partnerships, analyst shadowing, product instrumentation, and internal dogfooding before anything ships come naturally to you to increase the chances of success. Convert ambiguous market signal into a clear view of what to build and why.

  • Prioritise ruthlessly. Demand will always exceed capacity. Sequence zero-to-one bets against the needs of products customers depend on today, and say yes or no credibly, with reasoning people can engage with.

  • Execute with rigour, raising velocity and quality together. Own outcomes, not shipping dates. Use AI across your own workflow and your team's to learn faster and ship better at the same time, in a domain where mistakes carry real consequences.

 
 

What this role is not

  • Not a compliance officer role. You are building the products compliance teams use, not running a compliance programme.

  • Not a caretaker role. The core products are successful and deeply embedded; the mandate is reinvention.

  • Not a management-only layer. You will lead product managers and personally do product work on the hardest problems.

 
 

Who we're looking for

  • 10+ years building software products, including leading and developing product managers, with people who are better because they worked with you.

  • A genuine zero-to-one track record: an ambiguous problem in a complex domain, taken from nothing to a product real users depend on.

  • Depth in financial crime compliance from the product side (transaction monitoring, screening, KYC/EDD or investigations), built inside an exchange, a bank, a fintech or a compliance technology company.

  • Working knowledge of crypto and blockchain as a baseline; deep blockchain analytics experience is a strong plus.

  • AI-native: AI is embedded in how you work and build every day, you have shipped AI or agentic capabilities to production, and you raise the AI capability of teams around you. If AI has not materially changed how you build product in the last two years, this is not the right role.

  • Deep executional rigour: you break complex problems into shippable steps, sweat the details that determine quality, and reliably carry work over the line.

  • High self-sufficiency: you find high-value opportunities no one assigned you, create clarity rather than wait for it, and are comfortable owning a broad remit while the map is still being drawn.

  • Continuous systems thinking: you look for the repeatable system behind every one-off fix, building leverage so each problem solved makes the whole team permanently faster.

  • A data-informed operating style: you instrument what you ship, argue from evidence, and change your mind when the data disagrees.

  • Judgement under ambiguity: you know which decisions to make fast and which to hold open when precedent does not exist.

  • Comfort in regulated, high-stakes environments: you treat trust, explainability and defensibility as features, and operate well at the tension point between innovation and regulatory reality.

  • Restlessness about velocity and quality: you treat "that's just how long it takes" as a claim to be tested.

If you're energised by ownership, invention, and building side by side with customers in a high-stakes domain, we'd love to hear from you.

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Product Designer to join the OKX team, focused on VIP and Deposit & Withdraw experiences. You'll help guide the team's attention to UX craft and lead cross-functional design alignment and efficiency across our global apps. This pivotal role focuses on crafting dynamic and engaging experiences for our highest-value users and the deposit and withdrawal journeys that underpin every product on the platform, including how those journeys connect to Earn.

As part of this role, you will be part of a world-class team shaping how VIP users experience tiering, benefits, and recognition, as well as how all users move funds in and out of OKX across fiat and crypto rails. Collaboration is key in this position, as you will work closely with our global design, product, creative, strategy, engineering, and research teams to elevate the cutting edge of our product offerings. Your contributions will steer the development and implementation of new concepts for VIP and Deposit & Withdraw, deliver designs aligned with business objectives.

The right candidate for this role possesses a detail-oriented approach to user experience, with a passion for holistic product-design thinking. As a strategic partner to cross-functional teams, you should excel in adaptability and conversing with stakeholders, while continuing to maintain a focus on excellent user experience and product quality.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Leverage data, insights, and user feedback to bring human voices into problem statements, product interfaces, and user journeys
  • Generate ideas quickly, and connect regularly with customers to validate directions
  • Participate in design critiques and present work in product leadership feedback meetings
  • Own end-to-end design quality for VIP and Deposit & Withdraw, which includes advocating for UX craft and users
  • Design VIP tiering, benefits, and recognition experiences, including how Earn perks and bonuses surface for VIP users
  • Design deposit and withdrawal flows across fiat and crypto rails that are fast, trustworthy, and easy to follow
  • Co-lead the product development process, influencing strategic decisions improve the overall product experience, and ensure consistency
  • Partner with visual designers, product managers, user researchers, and engineers across markets to build and ship experiences that represent the company vision

  • Think systematically about UI patterns and reusable solutions, designing not just individual screens but scalable components that work across features and contexts
  • Contribute to and evolve our design system by identifying opportunities to abstract one-off designs into well-documented, flexible components that accelerate the team

What We Look For In You 

  • Must be native to crypto and have experience in investing in Cefi or DeFi
  • Requires 5-8 years of Product Design experience, with a Bachelor’s degree in Product Design, Web Design, or equivalent project/portfolio experience
  • Experience designing outstanding digital products in an agile development environment with cross-functional partners, backed by a portfolio that showcases modern design work and demonstrates your ability to design mobile-first digital
  • Deep understanding of human-centered design principles, and proficient in dissecting complex problems and tasks, translating them into user-centric, data-driven experiences that are intuitive and inclusive
  • Extensive background in developing digital products and experiences through comprehensive knowledge of user research, user experience, interaction design, and prototyping techniques, and demonstrated expertise in employing design methodologies and tools to facilitate cross-functional collaboration in understanding and meeting user needs
  • Skilled in thriving within a fast-paced environment, adept at managing multiple dependencies, prioritizing tasks independently, and demonstrating flexibility while proactively addressing challenges
  • Strong presentation, interpersonal and communication skills, with experience articulating complex and abstract concepts persuasively, providing rationale behind decisions, remaining open to feedback, and confidently representing viewpoints
  • Systems-level design thinking: you naturally spot patterns across flows and proactively create reusable, scalable components rather than solving each screen in isolation, with experience building, documenting, or contributing to a component library or design system

Nice to Haves

  • Experience working with teams across offices and US time zones
  • Experience using AI tools (Figma plugins, generative design, prompt-based prototyping) to accelerate design workflows and explore concepts faster
  • Experience using AI to build systematic design approaches, moving beyond screen-by-screen design to construct interactive, high-fidelity flows that can be explored and validated end to end

Highlights of Perks and Benefits

Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.


Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Our VIP team supports the firm's highest-value private clients across the Payward ecosystem: high-net-worth individuals (HNWIs) who expect a premium, secure, and highly tailored experience. We ensure Kraken remains the platform of choice for VIPs by delivering white-glove relationship management, personalized trading enablement, and high-impact benefits.

We are looking for a Senior VIP Relationship Manager, LATAM to help us scale our VIP client book and growth across the region. This is a hybrid role: part white-glove relationship management, part growth and business development. You'll build Kraken's presence inside LATAM's VIP trading and investor communities, run local marketing and events, and source new whale relationships.

We're looking for someone who isn't afraid to be bold, can build and scale initiatives from the ground up, and is humble enough to fail fast and move on to the next challenge. If you thrive in ambiguity and can operate in a fast-paced, scrappy environment, this role is for you.

 

The opportunity

  • Serve as the trusted point of contact for Kraken and Payward’s top private clients across LATAM, delivering consistent, high-quality white-glove service and building deep, durable relationships.

  • Own the regional VIP book end to end: onboarding, tier progression, retention, and proactive intervention on at-risk and lapsing clients.

  • Build lasting relationships that grow AOP, net deposits, and trading volume, your primary KPIs, by becoming the partner clients trust with more of their capital and activity over time.

  • Bring Kraken's private client and VIP offerings to market locally, including yield and earn campaigns, lending against tokenized equities and crypto collateral, OTC execution, and structured private-client benefits, ensuring they remain impactful and competitive against regional exchanges and desks.

  • Source and convert new HNWI relationships through direct outreach, referrals, and introducer networks, from crypto-wealthy individuals and family offices to the principals of trading firms, OTC desks, miners, and project treasuries.

  • Get inside LATAM's VIP trading communities: private trading groups, investor clubs, KOL and trader networks, and closed-door investor groups. Be the Kraken face those communities know and trust.

  • Design and run local marketing and events (VIP dinners, trader meetups, conference-adjacent programming, and co-marketing with regional partners and KOLs) in partnership with our Marketing and Regional teams.

  • Build and manage introducer and referral partnerships that produce a repeatable pipeline of qualified private clients.

  • Act as Payward’s ear on the ground: competitive intelligence on regional exchanges, product gaps that cost us whale business, and the local narratives that move capital.

  • Partner with Product, Marketing, Compliance, Banking, and Client Service to champion new efforts that drive private client growth and loyalty, and to make sure every play you run is inside Kraken's licensing and compliance perimeter.

 
 

What you bring

  • 5+ years of experience in relationship management, account management, private banking, brokerage, or private client sales, including at least 2 years in the crypto space, with a track record of working with HNWIs.

  • An existing, personal network among LATAM's crypto HNWIs, traders, family offices, OTC desks, funds, or trading communities in Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Colombia, or Chile.

  • Demonstrated ability to originate business, not just service it. You have personally brought in clients, run events, or built a community presence that produced measurable pipeline.

  • Deep understanding of trading product solutions, including spot, margin, and futures trading, as well as OTC trading, lending, and yield/earn products. Familiarity with how deposits and client balances drive an exchange's lending economics is a strong plus.

  • Comfort operating in a regulated environment across multiple LATAM jurisdictions, and the judgment to know when to involve Compliance early.

  • Highly data-driven, with expertise in analyzing KPIs such as assets on platform, net deposits, trading volume, and client portfolio revenue.

  • Ability to be scrappy, bold, and unafraid to explore alternative and creative solutions to achieve results.

  • Deep knowledge of cryptocurrency ecosystems, their players, frameworks, and market dynamics beyond just blue-chip tokens, including how local on/off-ramps and stablecoin flows shape client behavior in the region.

  • Skilled at building meaningful partnerships with internal and external stakeholders at all levels and across diverse backgrounds.

  • Willingness to travel up to 30% across the region for client meetings, events, and conferences.

  • Based in Brazil and native or near-native Portuguese plus fluent English required. Spanish is a strong plus.

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the Organization 

Payments is at the core of Stripe’s mission to increase the GDP of the internet. We are expanding our payments footprint in India and we are looking for Backend Engineers to own the technical architecture behind our next generation of payment offerings in India. 

As part of the India Payments team, you will build on top of Stripe’s robust foundational platforms, driving complex integrations and contributing to the architectural evolution of the critical services that handle money movement every millisecond. You will engineer the entire horizontal payments stack, driving every phase of a transaction's journey: integrating with local payment rails, managing initiation and intelligent routing, ensuring reliable completion and automating reconciliation and payouts. 

Partnering with cross-functional engineering hubs globally, you will tackle high-stakes technical challenges requiring low-latency execution, strict transactional idempotency, zero-downtime migrations and resilient distributed state management at scale.

If you thrive on taking ambiguous product mandates and turning them into fault-tolerant, self-healing distributed systems, you will feel right at home here.

What You’ll Do (Core Responsibilities)

  • Architect and operate low-latency, fault-tolerant backend microservices that integrate with Indian payment methods
  • Map complex, India-specific payment flows into Stripe’s global, unified API platforms, ensuring a seamless integration experience for developers worldwide
  • Design highly reliable adapter layers that interact with domestic banking partners and payment networks, building systems that gracefully handle external API latency and asynchronous callbacks
  • Own end-to-end service health, implementing shadow rollouts, distributed tracing, automated failovers and proactive alerting for 99.99% uptime
  • Collaborate with Product, Regulatory/Legal, Risk and Partner Integration teams across global engineering hubs while delivering seamless developer-facing APIs
  • Mentor and empower engineers to contribute independently through ongoing technical guidance and actionable feedback

Other Responsibilities

  • Independently scope, build and ship medium-to-large projects from ambiguous requirements to production
  • Build robust APIs that hide the extreme complexity of Indian payment rails behind simple, elegant developer experiences
  • Partner with product and data teams to proactively identify, size and solve the most impactful problems for our users
  • Engineer highly reliable, scalable infrastructure that consistently meets strict SLAs for all internal and external systems
  • Debug production issues across services and multiple levels of the stack with an eye towards improving maintainability over the long term
  • Improve engineering standards, tooling and processes
  • Accelerate team velocity through high-quality code reviews and architectural collaboration

Who you are

Minimum requirements

  • 8+ years of experience designing, implementing and operating large-scale, high-performance APIs and services
  • You have implemented server-side APIs in languages like Ruby, Java, or Go, working with document and relational datastores (especially Mongo and MySQL)
  • Empathetic, collaborative and user-first mindset in everything you build and have excellent oral and written communication
  • Experience proactively seeking feedback from users, teammates and subject matter experts
  • The ability to balance speed, complexity, and scope in service of user needs
  • Excellent oral and written communication

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience building large-scale financial systems, payments infrastructure or working in the broader fintech industry is a plus
  • Experience building distributed systems or operating within a complex microservices architecture
  • Proficiency in Ruby, Java, or Go, with deep experience modeling data in relational and document databases (e.g., MySQL, Mongo)
  • Experience driving technical alignment across global, cross-functional teams

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

Own Your Intelligence

 

Prime Intellect is building the open superintelligence stack: the infrastructure frontier AI labs build internally, made available to every ambitious AI team.

 

Our platform, Lab, unifies compute, environments, evaluations, secure sandboxes, high-performance training, and deployment into one full-stack system for post-training at frontier scale - from SFT and RL to tool use, agent workflows, and continuously improving production models. We are building open frontier AI: open-source models trained end to end for long-horizon tasks like autonomous research, and the full-stack platform our own research team uses to build them. The next generation of AI companies, enterprises, and research teams do not just need more GPUs. They need the ability to turn their own workflows, tools, data, and feedback loops into superintelligence they own.

 

Prime Intellect has raised $150M in total funding from Founders Fund, Radical Ventures, NVIDIA, and exceptional AI, infrastructure, and enterprise operators — including Andrej Karpathy, Dwarkesh Patel, and leaders and founders from Ramp, Perplexity, Harvey, Mercor, Zapier, Datadog, Cognition, OpenAI, Thinking Machines, Together AI, SemiAnalysis, LangChain, Browserbase, Cloudflare, Sierra, Databricks, Airbnb, OpenRouter, Standard Intelligence, Fleet, Core Auto, and more. We are looking for people who want to build at the intersection of frontier research, real infrastructure, and go-to-market for a category that does not fully exist yet.

Role Impact

You will build environments, evaluations, agent systems, and post-training methods with an external robotics team. You will train and evaluate agents with reinforcement learning, world modeling, imitation learning, planning, and multimodal perception, using feedback from simulation and deployed robots. The experiments will test behavior under partial observations, long horizons, changing environments, and hardware and safety constraints.

Responsibilities

Applied Research at Prime

We turn a workflow into tasks, environments, evaluations, and reward signals, run post-training experiments against real baselines, and deploy what works. When a result looks good, we find out whether the gain came from the model or from the data, harness, inference, or infrastructure. The reusable parts become shared research, open-source systems, and product capabilities.

Every Applied Research role is externally facing. Most researchers work directly with customers, users, or research partners while maintaining a substantive research agenda.

Representative early problems

  • Build aligned simulation and real-world evaluations for a long-horizon embodied task, then measure exactly where policies fail to transfer.

  • Combine demonstrations, interventions, offline data, and online feedback into a training loop that improves behavior without erasing prior competence.

  • Train an embodied agent to recover from partial failures, changing scenes, and uncertain state while respecting safety and hardware constraints.

What you will own

  • Simulation and real-world environments for training, evaluation, and careful sim-to-real comparison.

  • Long-horizon agents that perceive, plan, act, remember, and recover under hardware constraints.

  • Training that combines offline and online RL, demonstrations, interventions, and outcome feedback.

  • Rewards and evaluations for task success, safety, adaptation, and continual improvement without silent regressions.

Requirements

  • Relevant experience: robotics, embodied AI, RL, imitation learning, control, world models, simulation, computer vision, agent evaluation, or production systems interacting with the physical world.

  • Hands-on experience building and debugging model-training, post-training, agent, evaluation, or closely adjacent experimental loops.

  • Strong experimental judgment: meaningful baselines, careful trace inspection, clear failure attribution, and a willingness to change direction when the evidence changes.

  • Strong Python and the ability to build artifacts that other researchers and engineers can run, inspect, and extend.

  • Comfort owning ambiguous problems and keeping partners and teammates current as you resolve them.

Evidence of exceptional work

We value publications, open-source systems, benchmarks, and shipped products as evidence of exceptional work. Show us something difficult you built, what failed, and how the evidence changed your approach.

Benefits and Perks

  • Cash Compensation Range of $150-300k + equity incentives

  • Flexible Work (San Francisco, New York, London, or remote)

  • Visa Sponsorship & relocation support

  • Professional Development budget

  • Team Off-sites & conference attendance

If you're excited about the opportunity to build the foundation for the future of decentralized AI and create a platform that empowers developers and researchers to push the boundaries of what's possible, we'd love to hear from you.

About Polymarket

Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future.

We're growing fast, both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire.


About the Role

When the world's biggest stories break, whether that's an election night, a Fed decision or a championship game, people come to Polymarket to see what's likely to happen next. Millions of trades, price updates and market resolutions flow through our backend as events unfold, and every one of them has to be fast and correct. We're hiring Staff Backend Engineers to own and shape those systems as Polymarket grows into a global source of truth.

This is an individual contributor role with high autonomy and high ownership. You'll work alongside a small group of senior engineers who care deeply about correctness and performance. descriptions.job-01oua2d:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

As a Global Investigator on the triage team, you are the first line of operational response in a fast-moving crypto disruption pipeline. You process inbound victim complaints, validate the output of our AI investigation tooling, and route cases into the investigative workflows that lead to frozen scam proceeds, takedowns, and recovered assets. You hold the disposition pen: your call is what turns a complaint into a freeze, an escalation, a recovery handoff, a victim notification, or a close.

The impact you will have:

  • Validate and route hundreds of complaint dispositions each week, feeding a live asset-recovery pipeline that gets stolen funds frozen before they move.

  • Use AI first-pass output as a co-pilot and catch the errors that matter, such as false positives, merged syndicates, and misclassified scam patterns, before they propagate downstream.

  • Enrich complaint selectors with a broad stack of commercial data-source integrations and on-chain and off-chain checks to decide what is actionable.

  • Own clean shift handoffs so the around-the-clock operation never drops a lead, keeping the US-hours queue moving for the rest of the triage team.

  • Feed structured signal back to engineering on where the AI triage model misses, so it gets more precise every week.

What we’re looking for:

  • Investigative or analytical experience in the private or public sector. 1-3 years is fine; we want people who want to grow into deep crypto expertise.

  • Strong AI fluency, meaning comfort using AI tools as a daily co-pilot to work a high-volume queue, with the judgment to know when the output is wrong.

  • Baseline crypto knowledge and the ability to recognize threat types such as investment scams, pig-butchering, and ransomware, and comfort pairing that with AI-assisted analysis.

  • Able to prioritize and work independently, with clear written handoffs, during hours when the rest of the team is offline.

  • Receptive to feedback from experienced tracers and engineers, and motivated to improve the triage process rather than only clear tickets.

  • US Citizenship required

  • Ability to obtain Public Trust clearance

About the Team:

  • The team pairs seasoned crypto tracers with rising investigators. Triage investigators sit alongside experienced Global Investigators and intelligence-trained individual contributors, and the seat is built to accelerate your development toward deeper tracing work.

  • The work is operationally hard: high volume, real victims, and time-sensitive calls where a fast, accurate disposition can be the difference between funds frozen and funds gone.

Team Operating Rhythms:

  • Primary coverage during US business hours in your local time zone, holding triage throughput while colleagues in other regions are offline.

  • Distributed, not distant: async-first handoffs, clear written updates, and tight coordination with global teammates on time-sensitive items.

Required online and collaboration hours:

  • Schedule: Standard North American EST business hours preferred, with overlap for daily handover to and from other regions.

On-Call Responsibilities:

  • Schedule: Formal on-call rotation for high-priority events, such as active hacks, law-enforcement support, and other time-sensitive matters.

  • Frequency: Weekly rotation, with occasional weekend coverage; remote standby (free to go about your day and respond when paged), not worksite-bound.

Travel Requirements:

  • Schedule: Minimal; occasional team or mission offsites.

Onsite Requirements:

  • Distributed/remote role with no routine onsite requirement.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • Within your first 30 days, you are clearing live complaint surges end to end, turning raw victim reports into actionable freezes and escalations the same day they arrive.

  • Within 90 days, your prioritization calls are routinely accepted by Global Investigators, measurably shortening the time between a report landing and funds being frozen.

  • Each week, your feedback to engineering sharpens the AI triage model, so the whole team catches more recoverable cases with less manual review.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

Privacy Policy and Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form.

Recruitment agencies

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.

Technical win rate · POC-to-commercial conversion · Time to technical validation · Benchmark quality · Deployment readiness · Model Factory technical attach

The Opportunity

If you enjoy applying your quantitative and ML skills to real-world problems, coding production-quality analysis and tools, and working in a fast-paced environment with immediate and tangible feedback, our Summer Internship Program is ideal for you.

At Brevan Howard, we build systematic and discretionary investment processes that rely on rigorous analysis of a vast universe of data, such as asset prices, macroeconomic indicators, news, sell-side research, and trading signals.

Transforming this data into actionable insights is central to how we win, and we’re looking to find the next generation of portfolio managers and quants through our internship program—people who are eager to push the frontier of research and engineering in global macro investing.

What you will do

You will work directly with our front-office personnel to provide immediate impact on a range of projects:

  • Build pipelines to extract and analyse data, develop models and trading signals, and support decision-making of Portfolio Managers.

  • Integrate AI into analytical systems as well as building new AI-powered tools using the latest LLMs and agent workflows.

  • Contribute to our core analytics library, which is leveraged by Quants and PMs across the firm for research, trading and risk management.

How we will support you

Our Internship Program starts with one-week in-depth training to prepare interns for the desk. This covers a range of topics relevant for financial markets, including macroeconomics, traditional assets (fixed income, currencies, equity markets, and commodities), digital assets, trading strategies, risk management, and the latest AI tools and LLMs.

Additionally, you will benefit from key talks, a mentor program, social events and engagements with some of the most respected and talented individuals in their field. 

Why take this opportunity

This is a unique opportunity to gain insight into one of the world’s leading firms operating at the forefront of macro trading. At Brevan Howard, we believe the future of investing lies at the intersection of deep domain expertise and cutting-edge technology. As our industry is being reshaped by AI and automation, you’ll see first-hand how LLMs, retrieval, and agent-like systems are being used in the front-office environment at one of the world’s premier macro hedge funds – where correctness, robustness and speed matter.

Top performing interns are considered for our Graduate Program the following year and longer-term paths include roles as analyst, quant, and portfolio manager.

The Requirements

  • A penultimate year undergraduate or master's student in Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, Quantitative or a STEM-related field.

  • Solid coding skills.

  • A demonstrated interest in ML/AI and the ability to explain fundamental concepts.

  • Good written and verbal communication skills in English.

Finance/trading knowledge is a bonus but not a requirement: we care more about your ability to learn quickly, reason from data, solve problems, and build quality code.

About the Company

Rain is the global stablecoin payments platform for enterprises, neobanks, platforms, developers, and AI agents. Our technology allows partners to move, store, and use stablecoins instantly and compliantly through global payment cards, rewards, on/offramps, wallets, and cross-border rails. As both a Visa and Mastercard Principal Member, Rain issues cards that work at more than 175 million merchant locations in over 220 countries and territories. Built natively for stablecoins and trusted by more than 100 organizations worldwide, Rain delivers secure, scalable infrastructure that makes money move freely and instantly around the world.

You will have the opportunity to deliver massive impact at a hypergrowth company backed by some of the top investors in fintech, crypto, and SaaS. In January 2026, we closed a $250M Series C led by ICONIQ, valuing Rain at $1.95B, with Sapphire Ventures, Dragonfly, Bessemer Venture Partners, Galaxy Ventures, FirstMark, Lightspeed, Norwest, and Endeavor Catalyst also participating. If you're curious, bold, and excited to help shape a borderless financial future, we'd love to talk.

Our Ethos

We believe in an open and flat structure. You will be able to grow into the role that most aligns with your goals. Our team members at all levels have the freedom to explore ideas and impact the roadmap and vision of our company.

About the Role

AI agents are already booking travel, subscribing to software, running procurement end to end, and moving money on behalf of users — much of it through Rain. Our Agent Control Layer is the governing surface for that activity: it enforces approved counterparties, amounts, merchants, and task scope at initiation, before a transaction ever occurs, rather than reconciling damage after the fact.

We are hiring a Senior Product Manager to own that platform. This is a 0-to-1 role inside a category being defined in real time. You will own the developer-facing surface — APIs, SDKs, controls, docs — that teams building agents use to give them spending power safely. McKinsey projects $3–$5 trillion in global agentic commerce by 2030. The primitives that make it trustworthy have not been built yet. You will build them.

You will report to the Head of Product and work daily with engineering, risk and compliance, network partnerships, and the developers shipping on us.

What you'll do

  • Define the primitives for agent authority: spend scopes, merchant and counterparty allowlists, velocity and amount ceilings, task-bound credentials, human-in-the-loop approvals, and clean revocation.
  • Own scoped virtual cards for agents — cards provisioned for a single merchant, amount, and task, retired the moment the task completes.
  • Extend the rest of Rain's stack (wallets, virtual accounts, onramps, offramps, cross-border payments) to agent initiators within the parameters our customers define.
  • Treat the API as the product. Own endpoint design, error semantics, idempotency, webhooks, sandbox and simulation tooling, SDKs, and reference agents.
  • Own documentation and the onboarding path with the same rigor as the product itself. Time-to-first-authorized-agent-transaction is your metric.
  • Run a tight design-partner loop with agent builders — read their integration code, sit in their debugging sessions, ship against what you find.
  • Build the roadmap from first principles: form a thesis on where agentic commerce goes next, sequence bets accordingly, and kill what isn't working quickly.
  • Partner with risk and compliance on Know Your Agent — agent identity, attestation, delegated authority, auditability, and dispute handling in a world where the cardholder wasn't the one who clicked.
  • Represent Rain's technical point of view in Agentic Payments Alliance working groups and with Visa, Mastercard, and stablecoin partners as standards take shape.
  • Write the specs, launch posts, and positioning that teach the market what controlled agentic payments actually means.

You’ll likely succeed if you have

  • 8+ years in product management, with meaningful time on a developer-facing platform, API, or infrastructure product. You have shipped something engineers chose to build on.
  • Technical depth. You read API diffs, write your own queries, prototype against your own endpoints, and hold your own in an architecture review. You don't need to have been an engineer; you do need engineers to take you seriously.
  • 0-to-1 instincts. You have taken a product from a blank page to real usage in an ambiguous market, and you're comfortable with a roadmap that changes because the ground moved.
  • Payments or fintech fluency, or the obvious appetite to acquire it fast. Authorization flows, issuing, interchange, chargebacks, settlement, KYC/KYB - you know these, or you'll learn them in weeks rather than quarters.
  • Judgment under risk. Every control you design trades capability against loss. You can reason about that tradeoff explicitly and defend where you landed.
  • Strong writing. At Rain, specs, docs, and launch narratives are the job, not overhead.
  • Bias for motion. You would rather ship a narrow thing this month and learn from it than scope a broad thing for two quarters.

Bonus attributes

  • Hands-on experience building or deploying AI agents - tool use, orchestration frameworks, MCP, evals.
  • Stablecoin or onchain payments background: settlement, custody, treasury operations, or wallet infrastructure.
  • Experience working directly with card networks, issuing processors, or sponsor banks.
  • Time at an early-stage company during a period of fast scaling.

Things that enable a fulfilling, healthy and happy experience at Rain:

Unlimited time off 🌴 Unlimited vacation can be daunting, so we require Rainmakers to take 10 days minimum for themselves.

Flexible working ☕ We support a flexible workplace – work from home, come into an office, or both. We want everyone to work in an environment where they're their most confident and productive selves. New Rainmakers receive a stipend to set up a comfortable home workspace.

Easy to access benefits 🧠 For US Rainmakers, we cover 95% of your health, dental, and vision plan costs and 90% for your dependents, plus a 100% company-subsidized life insurance plan.

Retirement goals💡 Plan for the future with confidence. We offer a 401(k) with a 4% company match.

Equity plan 📦 Every Rainmaker gets an equity option plan so we all benefit from our success.

Health and Wellness 📚 High performance begins from within. Rainmakers receive a monthly stipend to be used for eligible health and wellness spending like gym memberships/fitness classes, massages, acupuncture - whatever recharges you!

In-office meals 🍜 Rainmakers working from the office enjoy lunch and dinner on us, covered with a DoorDash credit.

Team summits ✨ Summits play an important role at Rain. Time together helps us build relationships and a common destiny. Expect team and company offsites, both domestic and international.
